paragraphs: Sealed Tenders are called by registered post addressed to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram for supply of Vegetables & Fruits for a period of Six Month (01 st Oct, 2025 to 31 st Mar, 2026). Tender Form showing approximate required quantity along with the terms and conditions can be procured from the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram at a cost of Rs.118/- (100+18% GST) during 9 th Aug, 2025 to 23 rd Aug, 2025 in working hours on all working days. The last date for submission of the Tender Form is 23 rd Aug, 2025 up to 12:30 PM. Received Tenders will be opened in the Committee Room of Dean Office on 25 th Aug, 2025 at 12:00 Noon. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to reject any or all the Tenders without assigning any reasons.
